reason: I've never heard of Moduo, and I'm not moving my email, calendar and client notes into an app that has no Reddit threads or reviews telling me it's stable. What I pay for now works well enough, so the switching cost isn't worth $12 a month on a hunch.
objection: If this new app syncs my email or calendar badly, or the company folds, my whole client business is sitting in it. I need proof from other consultants that it's reliable before I trust it with that.
would_change_my_mind: A good number of independent reviews and Reddit threads from consultants who've used it for six months or more saying the Gmail and calendar sync is solid.
